jo-devex: Quick note — new next-sample for evals shows two DX issues in previews: (1) ephemeral token races surface 401 in browser SDK; (2) streaming shows one big final chunk on Vercel. Can we add a tiny mitigation in the sample?

kim-frontend: Yikes. What do you propose?

jo-devex: Short-term: initialize client with `retry: { retries: 1, authRetry: true }` and add a small TextDecoder pump shim using `response.body.getReader()` to emit incremental chunks in the demo. Also sequence embeddings before chat to avoid concurrent ReadableStream sharing.

alex-sdk: Sounds reasonable as a sample-only workaround. SDK changes should be opt-in (authRetry + stream.raw/granularity) and behind telemetry before flipping defaults.

kim-frontend: OK — update README with a one-line explanation and the shim snippet, land sample PR, and file a small SDK issue for opt-ins.

ci-bot: [ci] queued job 9912: examples/next-sample smoke test

jo-devex: Thanks — will open PR and ping reviewers. :thumbsup:
